content:
We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the described reaction (retro step). We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer). We have to search template catalog by criteria: functional groups broken/formed, bonds broken/formed, etc. The reaction is carbonyl-ene intramolecular: a carbonyl (ketone) and an alkene undergo ene reaction forming new C-C bond, converting C=C to C-C, C=O to C-O, forming hydroxyl and a five-membered ring. So functional groups broken: "ketone", "alkene". Formed: "hydroxyl", "five-membered_ring"? Not sure if functional groups list includes "hydroxyl". Could also specify bonds broken: C=O, C=C. Bonds formed: C-C, C-O. Also bond order changed: C=C to C-C (order changed from double to single) and C=O to C-O (order changed). The tool expects bonds broken/formed as "6-6" etc (atomic numbers). Might be easier to search by functional groups broken/formed.

First, we need list of available functional groups. Use get_available_functional_groups.
